descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S25 Client crosses midnight with a chart open: a live recording and a recovered failed save each list every line once (new Playwright spec)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice. (UAT 3.4)
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. … (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Chromium with page.clock installed at 23:58 local, the mocked speech recognizer (installSpeechRecognitionMock), a fresh Hospital patient. (a) Record M1 at 23:58, let page.clock run past midnight, record M2. …

When After each part, read rounding.get and open Prior Encounter Transcripts

Then (a) M1 once, in '<day> (prior)'; M2 alone in 'Most Recent'. (b) The recovered line once, in 'Most Recent'. (c) The recovered line once, in exactly one session

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U11 (no line twice) and U1 (not lost), from UAT 3.4 and TC-16. rounding.get history / transcript equality plus row counts, as prior-transcripts.spec.ts asserts. Covers the client half of the midnight fix (useEncounterCapture.ts transcriptDayRef) and the recovery branch at useEncounterCapture.ts:362-395, which decides re-append vs already archived; the server half is S17. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela; the triage is about a test issue and the result shown here is a full pass, so its status is kept.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

If a phone's clock passes midnight before the server's day does, the earlier line moves to 'Oct 14 (prior)' and the new line is filed under the phone's date (Oct 15) on every device.

Evidence: Allure 1f6a04f9, newspec-c record-only. Parts (a)/(b)/(c) pass as written; (b)/(c) are only partly covered. S25's then expects the device-day roll, but TC-16 U9 / UAT 3.8 say the server clock decides. useEncounterCapture uses the device clock. TC-16 Q9 is open. Same class as TC-19/S19.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

(a) record M1, fast-forward past midnight, record M2. (b)/(c) the first rounding:update that carries the bedside line fails at the socket; the device's recovery record for that line is then written to IndexedDB exactly as the cloud engine stores it (localAudio.ts) and the chart is reopened, which is when the app offers 'Recover bedside recording'; (c) moves the clock to the next day first. After each part rounding:get (JWT) and the Prior Encounter Transcripts rows. — (a) is fully automated. (b)/(c) are partly covered: the on-device test recogniser keeps no audio, so the spec writes the recovery record and reopens the chart; after the reload the failed line is neither in liveTranscriptRef nor on the server, so only the 'not held, append' branch of recoverAudio runs and (c) cannot fail on the midnight risk it was written for. The re-append vs 'already archived' branch (failed line still in the open page's live transcript) needs the cloud recording/transcription path (Chromium has a fake mic; the blocker is the cloud engine, not a microphone); it stays with the dictation runner / manual. (a)'s then expects the device-midnight roll while U9 (UAT 3.8) says server clock: the U9 comparison is recorded only, for Quinn.
